Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: eye-level, facing intersection, fov 90
- arterial road, 2-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks absent, curbs absent
- driveways: left, right; parking: on-street
- commercial building at center, 3 stories, brick, flat roof, at-street setback
- utilities: power lines, street lamp, trash can, bench
- landscape: grass strip
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 1985
Reagan era prosperity. A 1985 main street in transition — neon and backlit plastic overtaking hand-painted signs, a first small video rental shop among the old local stores.

CONDITION: busy — customers present, high activity, all pumps in use

PERIOD DETAILS
- BLUE PLATE DINER with a backlit sign and 'HOT COFFEE 45¢' in the window
- video arcade with a 'GAMES 25¢' neon sign and posters in the window
- corner drug store with backlit plastic channel letters reading 'PHARMACY'
- window signs: 'VHS OVERNIGHT RENTAL $2.99', 'CASSETTE TAPES $7.99'
- a bike rack with BMX bikes
- a coin-operated newspaper vending box on the corner
Typography: bold geometric sans-serif, early computer-influenced fonts.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 15 people TOTAL: 6 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 5 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 4 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a woman with big permed hair and shoulder pads window-shopping
- a jogger in a bright tracksuit and headband passing through
- a jogger in a tracksuit and headband
Clothing: men in acid wash jeans, windbreakers; women in shoulder pads, big permed hair. Fashion palette: neon pink, electric blue, purple. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 4 period vehicles, all different:
- 1981-1985 Ford Escort — small boxy economy hatchback — silver
- 1977-1990 Chevrolet Caprice — boxy full-size sedan, formal lines — charcoal gray
- 1973-1987 Chevrolet C/K — square body pickup, dual headlights — light blue
- 1983-1988 Ford Thunderbird — aero coupe, rounded — burgundy
Parked with gaps; no vehicle newer than 1985.
Parked vehicles hug the curb — parallel, each facing its lane's direction; none sideways, diagonal, or against traffic. Keep at least one full driving lane clear each way for through traffic.
PLACEMENT: the first one parked on the LEFT side near the corner; the rest parked on the RIGHT side. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, painted crosswalks
- utilities: overhead power lines standard, wooden utility poles

TREES
- deciduous tree at left: very young sapling
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — Kodacolor VR 200 or Fujicolor 100 look.
Color: slightly cool tones compared to 1970s. Grain: moderate grain, cleaner than 1975.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
SelectedVehicles: 1981-1985 Ford Escort — small boxy economy hatchback
1977-1990 Chevrolet Caprice — boxy full-size sedan, formal lines
1973-1987 Chevrolet C/K — square body pickup, dual headlights
